package rulefixtures

import (
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for repository_returns_framework_builder_to_upper_layer: Repositories that leak `*gorm.DB`, `sqlx.NamedStmt`, query builders, or raw rows to higher layers instead of returning results or domain abstractions.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type Article struct {
	ID        uint   `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Title     string `gorm:"size:256"`
	Content   string `gorm:"type:text"`
	Published bool   `gorm:"default:false"`
}

type ArticleRepo struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func NewArticleRepo(db *gorm.DB) *ArticleRepo {
	return &ArticleRepo{db: db}
}

func (r *ArticleRepo) All() *gorm.DB {
	return r.db.Model(&Article{})
}

func (r *ArticleRepo) ByCategory(category string) *gorm.DB {
	return r.db.Model(&Article{}).Joins("JOIN categories ON categories.id = articles.category_id").Where("categories.name = ?", category)
}

func (r *ArticleRepo) FilterPublished() *gorm.DB {
	return r.db.Model(&Article{}).Where("published = ?", true)
}

var _ = gorm.ErrRecordNotFound
